judgment.status_reasoning: A TC260 Secretariat practice guide, described in its foreword as a standards-related technical document giving practical guidance (page 2), which 'can be used to guide' generative AI service providers and departments (page 5). The notice released it to implement the Interim Measures and guide providers; it creates no obligations of its own. The PDF fetched again on 18 Oct 2026 is byte-identical to the copy of 14 Oct 2026, and nothing stored shows a later version or a withdrawal, so 'Published (non-binding, current)' and 'Non-binding' stand. It sets no in-force date.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published 2025-09-15 is the date under the Secretariat's signature on the notice; the notice was posted on 2025-09-22 (发布时间), which the notes give. The PDF's cover gives only 2025年9月. The notice was stored in this run as the record's secondary source, so it counts at most as alt-official; version 1 quoted the same notice page (same SHA-256), then stored as a further source of the discover run.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Government standards-body guidance on incident classification and emergency response for generative AI services under the Interim Measures (CN-03); in scope with no note.
